1.

To Thee, O Jesus, I would flee, Thou knowest me; To Thee, to Thee each morning new, And Thee alone; To Thee, when day to me doth smile, And all is bright, To Thee, when sun doth sink away, And night draws nigh.

2.

To Thee, O Jesus, first and last, With all my need; Thy love doth fill all lack In overflow; To Thee, my precious Saviour, Yea, Thee alone; Thou, who hast borne all my woe, Thou lovest me.

3.

Thy way, O Lord, teach me to walk, And not mine own, However narrow be the path, If it be Thine. Yea, if it be Thine, then it is good, O precious Lord; Thy love shall strengthen my courage, Thyself art near.
